Privacy Policy

Last updated November 17, 2026

This policy explains what information Sonder Protocol ("we", "us") collects when you visit this website or buy a product, how it is used, and the choices you have. We keep data collection to the minimum needed to sell and deliver digital products.

Information we collect

  • Purchase information. When you buy, checkout is handled by Stripe. Stripe collects your name, email address, billing details and card information. We never see or store your full card number. We receive your email, the order details and the payment status from Stripe so we can deliver your download and provide support.
  • Technical information. Like all websites, our hosting provider (Vercel) automatically processes your IP address, browser type, and the pages you request, so the site can load and stay secure. These logs are kept for a short period.
  • Information you send us. If you email us, we keep the message and your email address to respond.

We do not use advertising trackers, analytics cookies or tracking pixels, and we do not ask for an account or password.

Free tools

The Readiness Calculator runs entirely in your browser. The answers you enter are not sent to us or stored. The Live Map loads public data from the National Weather Service and the U.S. Department of Energy. It does not ask for your location. On the homepage, we show weather alerts for your state using an approximate location (state only) that our host estimates from your IP address. We do not store it.

Third-party services

  • Stripe processes payments under its own privacy policy.
  • Vercel hosts the site and securely stores the digital files you buy.
  • Google Fonts serves the site's typefaces, which means your browser connects to Google and shares your IP address with it. See Google's privacy policy.
  • Amazon Associates. Some gear links go to Amazon. If you click one, Amazon may set cookies to credit us with a commission on qualifying purchases. That happens on Amazon's site, under Amazon's privacy notice.

How we use information

We use it only to process your order and deliver your download, provide customer support, prevent fraud and abuse, keep the site secure, and meet legal, tax and accounting requirements.

We do not sell your data

We do not sell or rent personal information, and we do not share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We share it only with the service providers above, so they can perform services for us, or when the law requires it.

Retention

Order records are kept as long as needed for tax, accounting and dispute purposes, typically up to seven years. Support emails are kept while they are useful for helping you.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (including California under the CCPA/CPRA), you may have the right to know what personal information we hold about you, to get a copy of it, to have it corrected or deleted, and to opt out of its sale or sharing (we don't sell or share it). To make a request, email drsv0913@gmail.com. We will verify the request using the email address on your order. We will not treat you differently for using these rights.

Security

The site is served only over HTTPS. Payments are handled by Stripe, and downloads are protected by short-lived, payment-verified links. No method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, but we work to protect your information.

Children

This site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect their personal information.

Changes

We may update this policy. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
